items.headline: Governors Call for Federal AI Rules Without Sidelining States
items.excerpt: A bipartisan group of US governors is urging Washington to set rules for the most powerful artificial intelligence systems while allowing states to protect consumers, workers and children from the technology’s risks.

items.headline: Tower Records Becomes Latest Japan Retailer Hit by Data Breach
items.excerpt: Music retailer Tower Records Japan Inc. said customer information was leaked following unauthorized access, making it the nation’s latest retailer to disclose a data breach.

items.headline: China Objects to US Curbs on Telecoms’ Access to Phone Numbers
items.excerpt: China urged the US to withdraw a measure barring its three largest telecoms from directly obtaining US phone numbers, saying the action violates principles of nondiscrimination and fair competition.

items.headline: Australia Spy Chief Warns of Data Center, AI Risks, Age Reports
items.excerpt: Australia’s spy chief said that data centers and artificial intelligence risk exposing the nation to foreign interference and malicious state actors, according to an interview in The Age Sunday.

items.headline: Crowdstrike’s Talks With Zscaler Show AI-Led Cyber Consolidation
items.excerpt: A wave of multibillion-dollar takeovers is reshaping the cybersecurity industry as the biggest companies race to expand their defenses against increasingly sophisticated attacks powered by artificial intelligence.
